from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class SyntaxRollbackError(RuntimeError):
    pass


GIT_PREFIX = [
    "git",
    "-c",
    "core.autocrlf=false",
    "-c",
    "core.safecrlf=false",
]


def _run(
    cmd: list[str],
    *,
    cwd: Path,
    check: bool = True,
) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        cwd=str(cwd),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )
    if check and proc.returncode != 0:
        raise SyntaxRollbackError(
            f"{' '.join(cmd)} fehlgeschlagen: "
            f"{(proc.stderr or proc.stdout).strip()}"
        )
    return proc


def _git(
    repo: Path,
    *args: str,
    check: bool = True,
) -> str:
    return _run(
        [*GIT_PREFIX, *args],
        cwd=repo,
        check=check,
    ).stdout.strip()


def rollback_syntax_failures(
    repo: Path,
    base_ref: str,
    handoff: dict[str, Any],
    verifier: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    target_paths = {
        str(item)
        for item in handoff.get("target_paths", [])
    }

    syntax_paths = sorted(
        {
            str(item.get("path", "")).strip()
            for item in verifier.get("blockers", [])
            if item.get("code") == "SYNTAX_CHECK_FAILED"
            and str(item.get("path", "")).strip()
            in target_paths
        }
    )

    if not syntax_paths:
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "changed": False,
            "restored_paths": [],
        }

    branch = _git(
        repo,
        "branch",
        "--show-current",
    )
    if not branch.startswith("ai/job-"):
        raise SyntaxRollbackError(
            "Syntax-Rollback darf nur auf isolierten ai/job-* Branches arbeiten."
        )

    for rel_path in syntax_paths:
        exists = _git(
            repo,
            "cat-file",
            "-e",
            f"{base_ref}:{rel_path}",
            check=False,
        )
        proc = _run(
            [
                *GIT_PREFIX,
                "cat-file",
                "-e",
                f"{base_ref}:{rel_path}",
            ],
            cwd=repo,
            check=False,
        )
        if proc.returncode != 0:
            raise SyntaxRollbackError(
                f"Basisdatei fehlt für Syntax-Rollback: {rel_path}"
            )

        _git(
            repo,
            "restore",
            "--source",
            base_ref,
            "--staged",
            "--worktree",
            "--",
            rel_path,
        )

    staged = _git(
        repo,
        "diff",
        "--cached",
        "--name-only",
    )
    if not staged:
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "changed": False,
            "restored_paths": syntax_paths,
        }

    _run(
        [
            *GIT_PREFIX,
            "-c",
            "user.name=Hermclaw Runtime",
            "-c",
            "user.email=runtime@hermclaw.local",
            "commit",
            "-m",
            "Runtime: rollback syntax-broken target files to clean base",
        ],
        cwd=repo,
    )

    _git(
        repo,
        "push",
        "origin",
        f"HEAD:{branch}",
    )

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "changed": True,
        "restored_paths": syntax_paths,
        "branch": branch,
        "head": _git(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            "HEAD",
        ),
    }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Setzt ausschließlich syntax-defekte Ziel-Dateien "
            "deterministisch auf den bekannten Basisstand zurück."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument("--repo", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--base-ref", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--handoff", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--verifier", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    repo = Path(args.repo).resolve()
    handoff = json.loads(
        Path(args.handoff).read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )
    verifier = json.loads(
        Path(args.verifier).read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )

    result = rollback_syntax_failures(
        repo,
        args.base_ref,
        handoff,
        verifier,
    )

    Path(args.output).write_text(
        json.dumps(
            result,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    if result["changed"]:
        print(
            "[SYNTAX-ROLLBACK] Ziel-Dateien auf "
            "sauberen Basisstand zurückgesetzt: "
            + ", ".join(result["restored_paths"])
        )
    else:
        print(
            "[SYNTAX-ROLLBACK] Kein Rollback nötig."
        )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from model_runtime.rollback_syntax_failures import (
    rollback_syntax_failures,
)


def git(cwd: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [
            "git",
            "-c",
            "core.autocrlf=false",
            *args,
        ],
        cwd=str(cwd),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=True,
    )
    return proc.stdout.strip()


class SyntaxRollbackTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rolls_back_only_syntax_broken_target(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base = Path(tmp)
            remote = base / "remote.git"
            repo = base / "repo"

            git(base, "init", "--bare", str(remote))
            git(base, "clone", str(remote), str(repo))
            git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Test")
            git(repo, "config", "user.email", "test@example.invalid")

            (repo / "a.php").write_text(
                "<?php echo 'base';\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (repo / "b.php").write_text(
                "<?php echo 'base';\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            git(repo, "add", "-A")
            git(repo, "commit", "-m", "base")
            base_sha = git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
            git(repo, "push", "-u", "origin", "HEAD:main")

            branch = "ai/job-syntax-test"
            git(repo, "checkout", "-b", branch)
            (repo / "a.php").write_text(
                "<?php if (\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (repo / "b.php").write_text(
                "<?php echo 'good change';\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            git(repo, "add", "-A")
            git(repo, "commit", "-m", "agent")
            git(repo, "push", "-u", "origin", branch)

            result = rollback_syntax_failures(
                repo,
                base_sha,
                {
                    "target_paths": [
                        "a.php",
                        "b.php",
                    ]
                },
                {
                    "blockers": [
                        {
                            "code": "SYNTAX_CHECK_FAILED",
                            "path": "a.php",
                        }
                    ]
                },
            )

            self.assertTrue(result["changed"])
            self.assertEqual(
                (repo / "a.php").read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8"
                ),
                "<?php echo 'base';\n",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (repo / "b.php").read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8"
                ),
                "<?php echo 'good change';\n",
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
